protocol.status: Exploratory retrospective study; all available historical periods have been inspected in earlier research. No untouched-test or prospective claim.
protocol.model: Normalized finite fractional-integral weights on squared standardized return innovations; implicit graph diffusion; positive intercept and feedback below one.
protocol.parameter_selection: Equal-weight mean of 1/5/21-session normalized validation QLIKE, using all daily validation origins with complete 21-session targets. 252 trailing observations. Nuisance parameters fitted strictly before validation.
protocol.primary_score: Normalized QLIKE against summed squared returns centered at the common origin-fitted mean; compare all methods on identical origins.
protocol.inference: Paired circular block bootstrap 2000 replicates, blocks 5 and 10 origins, entire asset panel resampled together; nominal intervals, no family-wise significance claim.
protocol.mean_scope: Risk/variance forecasts; no claim of directional price-prediction improvement.
protocol.revision: Persistent asymmetric fractional diffusion; exploratory follow-up after inspecting the first study.
protocol.innovation_assumption: Conditionally symmetric unit-variance shocks for asymmetric expected-moment recursions.
protocol.initialization: Unit standardized variance and unit presample transformed squared innovations.
protocol.gjr: Independent Gaussian QMLE; omega>0, alpha,beta,gamma>=0; alpha+beta+gamma/2<.999; two fixed starts.
